no_owner.name: Unanet ERP ↔ Power BI
no_owner.owner_ruled_empty: Platform capability with no single seller. Unanet's own analytics page says users "can also use your favorite analytics tools, like Microsoft PowerBI, Tableau, and Qlik, to get insights from data in our suite", and its FAQ says Unanet ERP AE "supports integration with tools like Power BI, Tableau, and Qlik by providing access to consistent project and financial data". That is a data-access surface any BI tool consumes on equal terms. No Unanet Power BI connector product is named anywhere on it and none is sold. Same reading as the AECI-1020 window 6 ruling on Deltek Costpoint to Power BI. Read 2026-09-18.

no_owner.name: Power BI (manual)
no_owner.owner_ruled_empty: Platform capability with no single seller: Deltek publishes only generic database-connection guidance for Costpoint (ODBC / SQL connector), and no Deltek-published Power BI connector product exists. Any BI tool connects the same way, so no vendor sells this pairing.

no_owner.name: Power BI (manual)
no_owner.owner_ruled_empty: Oracle's own help article describes Power BI connecting through the generic Aconex Connected Cost REST APIs with an endpoint URL and an auth token. No packaged connector is built or sold by either side. The row's own AECI-698 note already reached this reading: the Cost REST API is "a general surface … no evidence that the API was built for Power BI", and records the call as deliberately the same as the Deltek Costpoint ODBC row. Identical to window 11's Unanet ERP to Power BI and Tableau rulings: one data surface, N interchangeable BI clients, no seller.
